essence: The mudrā’s special status derives from its cherished relation to both Śrī Rāma and Sarasvatī.
The mudrā called saptajihvā functions to please Vaiśvānara.
The conch-related mudrā known as gālinī is defined by its circulating motion.
Forming one hollow fist constitutes the kumbhamudrikā.
Kumbhamudrā is authoritatively declared to confer complete protection.
